summary: Republic of Armenia. Parliamentary democracy; note - constitutional changes adopted in december 2015 transformed the government to a parliamentary system.
rulers: President Vahagn KHACHATURYAN (since 13 March 2022); Prime Minister Nikol PASHINYAN (since 10 September 2021)
government: parliamentary democracy; note - constitutional changes adopted in December 2015 transformed the government to a parliamentary system
economy: upper-middle income, fast-growing Caucasus economy; stable fiscal and monetary regime but vulnerable to geopolitical shocks; economic and energy ties to Russia but seeking more EU and US trade; key copper and gold exporter; business-friendly and anti-corruption reforms; persistent unemployment; influx of migrants from Ukraine war easing GDP (PPP): $60.909 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Armenian Republic Armed Forces: Armenian Army (includes land, air, air defense forces) (2025) Expenditure: 5.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
